The '''''Rufescent''-class cargo hauler''' from [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo.]] was a common [[Walker/Legends|walker]] designed for cargo lifting and transport. It had a number of anchor points on its lifter arms that allowed it to be used for a variety of different functions. The ''Rufescent'' was popular among criminal organizations and vigilantes as an improvised combat vehicle, as the anchor points could be outfitted with weapons. While it was no match for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] combat vehicles, the small ''Rufescent'' was effective in environments where heavy walkers could not access.<ref name="Keeping the Peace">''[[Keeping the Peace]]''</ref>
